arxiv-1404-6389.title: Computing an Optimal Control Policy for an Energy Storage
arxiv-1404-6389.creator: Pierre Haessig, Thibaut Kovaltchouk, Bernard Multon, Hamid Ben Ahmed, Stéphane Lascaud
arxiv-1404-6389.description: Abstract We introduce StoDynProg, a small library created to solve Optimal Control problems arising in the management of Renewable Power Sources, in particular when coupled with an Energy Storage System. The library implements generic Stochastic Dynamic Programming (SDP) numerical methods which can solve a large class of Dynamic Optimization problems.

arxiv-2009-00516.title: Collider Physics at the Precision Frontier Journal: Physics Reports
arxiv-2009-00516.creator: Gudrun Heinrich
arxiv-2009-00516.description: Abstract The precision frontier in collider physics is being pushed at impressive speed, from both the experimental and the theoretical side. The aim of this review is to give an overview of recent developments in precision calculations within the Standard Model of particle physics, in particular in the Higgs sector.

arxiv-2103-13072.title: Bosonization study of a generalized statistics model with four Fermi points
arxiv-2103-13072.creator: Sreemayee Aditya 1 and Diptiman Sen 1,2
arxiv-2103-13072.description: Abstract We study a one-dimensional lattice model of generalized statistics in which particles have next-nearest-neighbor hopping between sites which depends on the occupation number at the intermediate site and a statistical parameter ϕ \phi . The model breaks parity and time-reversal symmetries and has four-fermion interactions if ϕ ≠ 0 \phi\neq 0 .

arxiv-2110-04331.title: MusicNet: Compact Convolutional Neural Network for Real-time Background Music Detection
arxiv-2110-04331.creator: Chandan K.A. Reddy, Vishak Gopal, Harishchandra Dubey, Sergiy Matusevych, Ross Cutler, Robert Aichner
arxiv-2110-04331.description: Abstract With the recent growth of remote work, online meetings often encounter challenging audio contexts such as background noise, music, and echo. Accurate real-time detection of music events can help to improve the user experience. In this paper, we present MusicNet, a compact neural model for detecting background music in the real-time communications pipeline.

arxiv-2211-06465.title: Revisiting the double-soft asymptotics of one-loop amplitudes in massless QCD Preprint: P3H-22-111, TTK-22-37
arxiv-2211-06465.creator: Michał Czakon, Felix Eschment and, Tom Schellenberger
arxiv-2211-06465.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michał Czakon, Felix Eschment and, Tom Schellenberger. We evaluate the one-loop soft current for the emission of two soft gluons or a soft quark-anti-quark pair in massless Quantum Chromodynamics. The results are exact in dimensional regularisation up to a single Feynman integral. Two terms of the Taylor series of the latter integral as a function of ϵ ≡ ( 4 − d ) / 2 \epsilon\equiv(4-d)/2 with d d the dimension of spacetime are available from a recent calculation of one-loop triple-collinear splitting functions.

arxiv-2212-13091.title: K K -polynomials of multiplicity-free varieties
arxiv-2212-13091.creator: Federico Castillo, Yairon Cid-Ruiz, Fatemeh Mohammadi, Jonathan Montaño
arxiv-2212-13091.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Federico Castillo, Yairon Cid-Ruiz, Fatemeh Mohammadi, Jonathan Montaño. We describe the twisted K K -polynomial of multiplicity-free varieties in a multiprojective setting. More precisely, for multiplicity-free varieties, we show that the support of the twisted K K -polynomial is a generalized polymatroid. As applications, we show that the support of the Möbius function of a linear polymatroid is a generalized polymatroid and we settle a conjecture of Monical, Tokcan and Yong regarding Grothendieck polynomials for the case of zero-one Schubert polynomials.

arxiv-2309-10248.title: What is the Best Automated Metric for Text to Motion Generation? 509 Conference: SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers; December 12–15, 2023; Sydney, NSW, Australia SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers (SA Conference Papers ’23), December 12–15, 2023, Sydney, NSW, Australia DOI: 10.1145/3610548.36181
arxiv-2309-10248.creator: Jordan Voas, Yili Wang, Qixing Huang, Raymond Mooney
arxiv-2309-10248.description: Abstract . There is growing interest in generating skeleton-based human motions from natural language descriptions. While most efforts have focused on developing better neural architectures for this task, there has been no significant work on determining the proper evaluation metric. Human evaluation is the ultimate accuracy measure for this task, and automated metrics should correlate well with human quality judgments.

arxiv-2405-06006.title: PowerLine Unmanned Surfer (PLUS): Shape Adaptive Dynamics Development and Control Design
arxiv-2405-06006.creator: Ujjval Patel, Francis Phillips, Todd Henry, Imraan Faruque
arxiv-2405-06006.description: Abstract This paper introduces the powerline unmanned surfer (PLUS) concept to extend the limited endurance of fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) via in-flight energy harvesting from overhead electrical distribution power lines, and develops the flight dynamics and control framework to support centimeter-scale longitudinal powerline frequency tracking.

arxiv-2407-17617.title: Adaptive Robot Detumbling of a Non-Rigid Satellite
arxiv-2407-17617.creator: Longsen Gao, Claus Danielson, Rafael Fierro
arxiv-2407-17617.description: Abstract The challenge of satellite stabilization, particularly those with uncertain flexible dynamics, has become a pressing concern in control and robotics. These uncertainties, especially the dynamics of a third-party client satellite, significantly complicate the stabilization task. This paper introduces a novel adaptive detumbling method to handle non-rigid satellites with unknown motion dynamics (translation and rotation).

arxiv-2411-14770.title: Aim My Robot: Precision Local Navigation to Any Object Thanks: Xiangyun Meng, Sanghun Jung and Dieter Fox are with the Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering, University of Washington, Seattle, WA 98195, USA {xiangyun,shjung13, fox}@cs.washington.edu Thanks: Xuning Yang, Fabio Ramos,
arxiv-2411-14770.creator: Xiangyun Meng, Xuning Yang, Sanghun Jung, Fabio Ramos
arxiv-2411-14770.description: Abstract Existing navigation systems mostly consider “success” when the robot reaches within 1 m \mathrm{m} radius to a goal. This precision is insufficient for emerging applications where the robot needs to be positioned precisely 1 1 1 We use the word “precise” to indicate both low error and high consistency.

arxiv-2502-05665.title: Search for \PGg ​ \PH \PGg\PH production and constraints on the Yukawa couplings of light quarks to the Higgs boson
arxiv-2502-05665.description: Abstract A search for \PGg ​ \PH \PGg\PH production is performed with data from the CMS experiment at the LHC corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv at a proton-proton center-of-mass collision energy of 13 \TeV . The analysis focuses on the topology of a boosted Higgs boson recoiling against a high-energy photon.

arxiv-2602-04939.title: SynthForensics: A Multi-Generator Benchmark for Detecting Synthetic Video Deepfakes
arxiv-2602-04939.creator: Roberto Leotta ∗ Salvatore Alfio Sambataro ∗ Claudio Vittorio Ragaglia Mirko Casu iCTLab s.r.l. University of Catania University of Catania University of Catania Yuri Petralia Francesco Guarnera Luca Guarnera Sebastiano Battiato iCTLab s.r.l. University of Catania University of Catania University of
arxiv-2602-04939.description: Abstract The landscape of synthetic media has been irrevocably altered by text-to-video (T2V) models, whose outputs are rapidly approaching indistinguishability from reality. Critically, this technology is no longer confined to large-scale labs; the proliferation of efficient, open-source generators is democratizing the ability to create high-fidelity synthetic content on consumer-grade hardware. This makes existing face-centric and manipulation-based benchmarks obsolete.

pmc-10719055.title: Benchmarking the nutrient composition and labelling practices of finger foods and snacks for older infants and young children across seven Southeast Asian countries
pmc-10719055.creator: Alissa M Pries, Eleonora Bassetti, Jessica M White, Anzélle Mulder, Diane Threapleton, Jessica Blankenship
pmc-10719055.description: Ensuring consumption of nutrient‐dense, safe and appropriate complementary foods among older infants and young children (IYC) 6–36 months of age is critical for enabling optimal growth and development. The ubiquitous availability of and high demand for commercially packaged snack foods has culminated in a growing trend of snack food products specifically produced and promoted for older IYC.

pmc-10752199.title: Relative Position of the First Ray and Patient Reported Outcome Measures Following the Modified Lapidus Procedure: a Weightbearing CT Study
pmc-10752199.creator: Christopher C Cychosz, Rami Mizher, Matthew S Conti, Scott J Ellis
pmc-10752199.description: Category:Bunion; Midfoot/ForefootIntroduction/Purpose:Hallux valgus is a complex three-dimensional deformity, and the modified Lapidus is a commonly used procedure to correct moderate to severe deformities. Shortening and elevation of the first ray are two potential factors that may predispose to increased pressure on the lesser metatarsal heads.

pmc-11338547.title: GSK3B inhibition reduced cervical cancer cell proliferation and migration by modulating the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition
pmc-11338547.creator: Yanhong Zheng, Yang Yang, Weiyan Zhu, Ruhao Liu, Aodong Liu, Runfeng Zhang, Weixing Lei, Shifeng Huang, Yongzhu Liu, Qinglan Hu
pmc-11338547.description: Previous studies show that glycogen synthase kinase 3β (GSK3B) plays an important role in tumorigenesis. However, its role in cervical cancer is unclear. The present study silenced GSK3B with siRNAs and/or chemical inhibitors to determine its role in HeLa cervical cancer cell proliferation and migration as well as in xenograft tumor growth.

pmc-11451147.title: Emergency department physiotherapists: consideration of perceived barriers and facilitators to help optimise their role in the Australian emergency department
pmc-11451147.creator: Tina Vickery, Lindsey Brett, Taryn Jones
pmc-11451147.description: QuestionsWhat are the current barriers and facilitators to the role of ED physiotherapists? pmc-11586399.description: Not all patients on dialysis want to be registered on the kidney transplantation (KT) waiting list and undergo transplantation. The aim of this convergent mixed methods study was to determine the features of patients refusing to be registered on the KT waiting list and the reasons.

pmc-12467031.title: Multi-Strategy Honey Badger Algorithm for Global Optimization
pmc-12467031.creator: Delong Guo, Huajuan Huang
pmc-12467031.description: The Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA) is a recently proposed metaheuristic optimization algorithm inspired by the foraging behavior of honey badgers. The search mechanism of this algorithm is divided into two phases: a mining phase and a honey-seeking phase, effectively emulating the processes of exploration and exploitation within the search space.

pmc-12488854.title: Backflow H+ during interfacial polymerization matters to configure spatial charges of polyamide membranes
pmc-12488854.creator: Yawei Gao, Xiao-mao Wang, Shuming Liu
pmc-12488854.description: Well-compatible with current industrial manufacturing and diverse applications, interfacial polymerization (IP) and IP-based polyamide nanofiltration membranes have evoked extensive research. Wherein, aside from tailoring pore sizes, regulating charged features of membranes remains challenging. Re-visiting principles of interfacial amide condensation, HCl byproducts are found exerting disparate effects in interfacial diffusion and ensuing amidation reaction.

pmc-12535783.title: Design and optimization of a multiplex real-time PCR assay for detection of Hepatitis C virus (HCV), Human immunodeficiency virus-1 (HIV-1) and Human hepegivirus-1 (HHpgV-1)
pmc-12535783.creator: Paria Pirasteh, Seyed Reza Mohebbi, Seyed Masoud Hosseini, Shabnam Kazemian, Amir Ghaemi, Abolfazl Fateh, Mohammad Reza Zali
pmc-12535783.description: Aim:The objective of this study was to develop a real-time PCR method to detect hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus-1 (HIV-1), and also recently discovered human hepegivirus-1 (HHpgV-1) through melting curve analysis using SYBR Green dye in a single reaction.

pmc-12540853.title: Seismic oceanography data in the Gulf of Cadiz
pmc-12540853.creator: Ana F Duarte, Renato Mendes, Leonardo Azevedo
pmc-12540853.description: The study of the ocean is challenging due to its complex nature, vastness and harsh environment that make its exhaustive sampling impractical. We present a set of eight multichannel seismic reflection sections acquired in the Southern and Southwestern margins of Portugal.

pmc-12590694.title: The impact of 4-week high-intensity interval training on mental health and sleep quality in female college students with normal weight obesity: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12590694.creator: Jiawen Fu, Wangyi Zhang, Xinyi Xu, Xinyi Mao, Liyan Wang, Ming Cai, Ruoyu Yang
pmc-12590694.description: BackgroundNormal Weight obesity, characterized by normal-range body mass index accompanied by elevated adiposity, poses a potential health challenge among female college students. This demographic exhibits heightened susceptibility to psychological disturbances and sleep disorders. High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) appears to have potential in managing metabolic dysregulation.

pmc-12610268.title: Quaternary Ammonium Dimethacrylates as an Additive in Dental Composite Resins: A Review of Their Antimicrobial, Mechanical, and Physicochemical Properties
pmc-12610268.creator: John Ekow Ampah-Essel, Izabela Barszczewska-Rybarek, Patryk Drejka, Grzegorz Chladek, Eugenio Velasco-Ortega
pmc-12610268.description: Dimethacrylate-based dental materials are dominantly used in restorative procedures for their mechanical and esthetic properties. However, they lack inherent antimicrobial activity, making them susceptible to microbial colonization. This has prompted the development of quaternary ammonium dimethacrylate monomers (QADMs) as a counteractive measure.

pmc-12631135.title: ﻿A new species of Chanohirata (Hemiptera, Cicadellidae, Deltocephalinae, Penthimiini) from southern China with its complete genome
pmc-12631135.creator: Mingming Sun, Tielong Xu, Guy Smagghe, Renhuai Dai, Xianyi Wang, Jiajia Wang
pmc-12631135.description: ﻿AbstractThe genus Chanohirata Hayashi & Machida, 1996 is the second most speciose genus within the tribe Penthimiini, after Penthimia Germar, 1821 and is nearly endemic to China. This study provides the description of a new species, Chanohirata pala Sun, Xu & Dai, sp. nov., discovered in Yunnan, southern China and a phylogenetic analysis including this and related taxa.

pmc-12743696.title: Transauricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation in Acute Ischaemic Stroke Requiring Mechanical Thrombectomy: Sham-Controlled, Randomised Device Trial
pmc-12743696.creator: Gareth L. Ackland, David Crane, Sanjali Ahuja, Amour Patel, Tim Martin, Mareena Joseph, Onika Ottley, Rizwan Hameed, Priyanthi Dias, Salma Begum, Johannes Schroth, Russ Hewson, Ana Gutierrez del Arroyo, Tom E. F. Abbott, Pervinder Bhogal
pmc-12743696.description: Autonomic dysfunction leads to hemodynamic instability and immunosuppression after ischaemic stroke, and is independently associated with worse outcomes. We hypothesized that non-invasive peripheral neuromodulation, using transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (tVNS), may reduce blood pressure variability and/or reverse immunosuppression early after ischaemic stroke requiring mechanical thrombectomy (MT).

pmc-12983856.title: Changes in the prevalence of adolescent tobacco use and its associated factors in Indonesia: analysis of repeated cross-sectional survey 2009–2019
pmc-12983856.creator: Antonius Yansen Suryadarma, Sigit Ari Saputro, Ronny Isnuwardana, Monita Destiwi, Philip Etabe Bassey, Santi Martini, Susy Katikana Sebayang
pmc-12983856.description: AbstractBackgroundAdolescent tobacco use (ATU) is a global public health concern, causing significant morbidity and premature death. This study aimed to assess trends in the prevalence of ATU in Indonesia between 2009 and 2019 and to identify factors contributing to the observed changes.

pmc-13158905.title: Effectiveness of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) for the Management of Postsurgical Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial (SPINE‐ACT Study)

pmc-13158905.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThis randomized controlled trial evaluated the effectiveness of group‐based online Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) compared with treatment as usual (TAU) in improving postsurgical outcomes in patients with degenerative lumbar conditions.MethodsA total of 91 participants scheduled for lumbar surgery were randomly assigned to either ACT or TAU, with primary analyses conducted in a modified intention‐to‐treat sample of participants who underwent surgery (n = 54).

pmc-13236782.title: Sociodemographic Factors related to Financial Toxicity among Cancer Patients and Survivors:“The Second Cancer Patient Experience Survey” — A Nationwide Study in Japan
pmc-13236782.creator: K Suga, Y Ito, K Inoue, Y Ichinose, T Higashi, N Kondo
pmc-13236782.description: PurposeFinancial toxicity (FT) refers to increased risk of treatment discontinuation and anxiety in daily life due to the cost burden of cancer treatment. However, little is known about which groups of patients are more likely to experience FT under universal health coverage. Thus, we aimed to explore demographics and psychological factors associated with FT among adult cancer patients in Japan.

pmc-13332473.creator: Yang Hao, Yuqiang Qian, Da Liu, Fuhou Li, Hengzong Zhou, Minjun Jin, Chengcheng Li, Tianjia Liu, Dongxu Wang
pmc-13332473.description: Restrictions or prohibitions on the use of antibiotics in pig feed for growth promotion have been introduced in many countries. These compounds include natural extracts from animals, plants, and microorganisms, as well as their chemically synthesized counterparts.

pmc-13411570.creator: Jialu Yu
pmc-13411570.description: Antibiotic contamination, particularly by tetracycline hydrochlorides, poses a severe threat to marine benthic ecosystems. This study investigates the differentiated toxicological effects and molecular defense mechanisms of the marine ciliate Euplotes vannus when exposed to three structurally similar tetracyclines: chlortetracycline hydrochloride (CTC), doxycycline hydrochloride (DOX), and tetracycline hydrochloride (TCH).

This study expanded an unsupervised clustering algorithm, based on Levenshtein distance, to track and predict variant predominance across six European countries from 2020 to January 2024.

pmc-13646428.creator: Angelica Pistoia, Maria Ida Rizzo, Francesca R. Grippaudo, Marta Cajozzo, Francesca Grussu, Francesco Molinaro, Francesca Nascimben, Mario Zama
pmc-13646428.description: ObjectiveTo compare long-term esthetic and morphological outcomes of unilateral cleft lip (UCL) repair using the Millard rotation-advancement versus the Tennison-Randall triangular flap technique, testing whether Millard provides superior lip symmetry.DesignRetrospective cohort study.SettingSingle tertiary cleft center.Patients, ParticipantsForty adults aged 18-25 were selected from 168 patients treated between 1988 and 1995.

pmc-13653839.title: Revealing 3-hydroxybenzoate-4-hydroxylase from Pseudarthrobacter phenanthrenivorans Sphe3 via In-Cell NMR analysis and molecular cloning
pmc-13653839.creator: Stamatia Asimakoula, Alexandra Primikyri, Epameinondas Tsagogiannis, Anna-Irini Koukkou
pmc-13653839.description: This study aims at the functional and kinetic characterization of 3-Hydroxybenzoate-4-Hydroxylase (3HB4H) from Pseudarthrobacter phenanthrenivorans Sphe3.
